channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Japan eyes early contribution payment to ICC as court faces U.S. sanctions
item.description: If the sanctions are fully implemented as early as April next year, the ICC could be cut off from dollar-based settlements.

item.title: Japan eyes education programs for U.S. troops in Okinawa after recent robbery-murder
item.description: Among the recurrence prevention measures, which were agreed upon by both sides, are lectures on Okinawa's culture and history.

item.title: Japan picks 28 priority items for ¥370 trillion in investments
item.description: The priority items, which were picked from 62 products and technologies, include semiconductors and artificial intelligence.

item.title: BOJ’s Ueda says unclear how long 2% inflation rate will remain
item.description: Gov. Kazuo Ueda indicated an awareness that the goal had been reached hasn't yet become embedded among the broader Japanese public.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
